name: Nzefu-Loi
body:
NZEFU-LOI
CR 3

This thick-bodied beast has a long neck and smallish head with short, heavy tusks and a loose, hairy tail like a horse.

XP 800
N Large animal
Init -1; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 8, flat-footed 14 (–1 Dex, +6 natural, –1 size)
hp 59 (6d8+12)
Fort +7, Ref +5, Will +6; +4 vs. mind-affecting
Defensive Abilities stubborn mind

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 10 ft.
Melee gore +7 (1d8+6) or stomp +7 (2d6+6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks capsize

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 8, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 9
Base Atk +4; CMB +9 (+11 bull rush); CMD 18 (20 vs. bull rush, 22 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Perception +9, Swim +16
SQ hold breath

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Capsize (Ex)

A nzefu-loi can overturn a boat of its size or Smaller by ramming it as a charge attack and making a CMB check. The DC of this check is 25 or the result of the boat captain’s Profession (sailor) check, whichever is higher.

Stubborn Mind (Ex)

A nzefu-loi has a +4 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, and Handle Animal checks against them automatically fail.

This riverine herbivore is sometimes called a “water elephant” but its body more strongly resembles a hippopotamus in girth and shape. The nzefu-loi is not aggressive but is stubborn and not amenable to training and domestication.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm rivers
Organization solitary
Treasure none
